# Oat ring cereal

For a buyer the practical points are the form bought, the basis a result is reported on, where the oat ring cereal came from and the laboratory’s reporting limit. Testing finds contamination but does not remove it.

<div class="hmi-analyte-explorer" id="hmi-occurrence-oat-ring-cereal" data-analyte-explorer data-compact-intro="true" data-source-summaries="true"><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-explorer-context><summary data-open-context aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="hmi-occurrence-oat-ring-cereal-drawer">Comparison methods and scope</summary><div data-explorer-context-content>

<p>Each row is one statistic a source reports for one form of oat ring cereal, group and metal; percentiles, ranges and maxima reported for the same samples as a mean or median are shown on that row. Different forms and preparation states are kept apart, and dry-weight results never share a reference with as-sold or fresh-weight results. Ratings place a result against an HMI reference built from monitoring results and ordinary-setting medians for the same form and basis. Same-study contrasts compare a contaminated or treated site with its control, targeted with random sampling, a prepared form with the unprocessed one, or one group of a study with the median of its other groups. Held rows failed a check against their own source and are shown but not compared.</p>

data-shared-occurrence-methods><summary>Shared dataset methods and interpretation</summary><div data-shared-evidence-content><p>Source summaries retain their original statistic, material, basis and censoring. Each source drawer identifies methods and overlapping samples. No matched reference or pooled distribution is inferred.</p></div></details><details class="hmi-drawer-disclosure" data-baseline-fallback id="hmi-reference-hmi-pooled-reference-v2:oat-ring-cereal-434d9583b10f:ca05e3d221a1"><summary>HMI oat ring cereal Pb reference · Oat ring cereal, as sold</summary><div data-baseline-reference-template="hmi-pooled-reference-v2:oat-ring-cereal-434d9583b10f:ca05e3d221a1"><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Reference and scope</p><p>HMI oat ring cereal Pb reference · Oat ring cereal, as sold. Oat ring cereal, as sold; As sold, as eaten or fresh weight, µg/kg; no moisture conversion. Distribution of subgroup median concentration values.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Reference (µg/kg)</th><th scope="col">Q1</th><th scope="col">Median</th><th scope="col">Q3</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Primary HMI reference</td><td>≤5.2</td><td>4.7–6.5 (bounded)</td><td>6.2–10 (bounded)</td></tr><tr><td>Alternative weighting</td><td>≤5.2</td><td>4.7–6.5 (bounded)</td><td>6.2–10 (bounded)</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p>12 reference units; 2 sampling families. Counts describe evidence units, not independent studies or certainty.</p><div class="hmi-drawer-table"><table><thead><tr><th scope="col">Contributing family</th><th scope="col">Reference units</th><th scope="col">Weight</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>WHO GEMS/Food</td><td>6</td><td>50%</td></tr><tr><td>FDA Total Diet Study</td><td>6</td><td>50%</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p class="hmi-drawer-section-title" role="heading" aria-level="3">Methods</p><p>HMI pools subgroup medians for oat ring cereal, as sold on a as sold, as eaten or fresh weight basis: monitoring results summarized as one median per reporting region, sampling type and collection year, total diet composites and printed sample values as single observations, and printed subgroup medians from ordinary farms or markets. Each sampling family has equal total weight. Non-detects stay as zero-to-limit intervals, so quartiles carry lower and upper bounds. Means, ranges and maxima never enter as observations. Other forms, other bases, targeted sampling and results from mining, industrial, wastewater-affected, experimental, fertiliser or manufacturer settings are kept out of this reference.</p><p>Inverse weighted empirical CDF; midpoint at exact cumulative-weight boundaries. At least four reference units and a definitely positive Q1 to Q3 spread are required. </div>

<details class="qa" data-hmi-faq="1" id="how-much-of-the-arsenic-in-oat-ring-cereal-is-inorganic" data-anchor="how-much-of-the-arsenic-in-oat-ring-cereal-is-inorganic" data-question="How much of the arsenic in oat ring cereal is inorganic?">
<summary><span class="mk" aria-hidden="true"></span>How much of the arsenic in oat ring cereal is inorganic?</summary>
<div class="ans" data-hmi-faq-answer="1">

Inorganic arsenic, the more toxic form, was measured in 32 results from 1 source, far fewer than total arsenic.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2016</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic">Analytical Results from Inorganic Arsenic in Rice Cereals for Infants, Non-Rice Infant Cereal and Other Foods Commonly Eaten by Infants and Toddlers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">U.S. Food and Drug Administration</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic">Read source →</a></span></span></sup> U.S. Food and Drug Administration 2016 reported inorganic arsenic at 17.2 µg/kg (mean) in oat ring cereal, as sold from all samples.<sup class="cite">[[sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic|5]]<span class="cite-card"><span class="cite-card-head"><span class="cite-card-authors">U.S. Food and Drug Administration · 2016</span><a class="cite-card-title" href="../sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic">Analytical Results from Inorganic Arsenic in Rice Cereals for Infants, Non-Rice Infant Cereal and Other Foods Commonly Eaten by Infants and Toddlers</a></span><span class="cite-card-body"><span class="cite-card-journal">U.S. Food and Drug Administration</span><a class="cite-card-review" href="../sources/fda2016-infant-toddler-foods-inorganic-arsenic">Read source →</a></span></span></sup>

</div>
</details>
